profile.name: Jastrzebska Spólka Weglowa S.A.
profile.summary: Jastrzebska Spólka Weglowa S.A. engages in the extraction, production, and sale of coal, coke, and hydrocarbons in Poland, Austria, the Czech Republic, Germany, Slovakia, Belgium, Spain, Norway, Switzerland, Romania, Luxembourg, Holland, and France. It operates through Coal, Coke, and Other segments. The company also provides maintenance, inspection, renovation, and repairs service of machinery and equipment; technical research services; and chemical and physiochemical analyses of minerals, as well as solid, liquid, and gaseous materials and products. In addition, it is involved in the provision of railway lines; maintenance of railway infrastructure, and structures and equipment; construction and repair of railway track and facilities; security and auxiliary services; water and sewage-related services; discharge of saline mine water; supply of industrial water; reclamation activities; and production of salt. Further, the company engages in the provision of construction, IT services, cybersecurity, software and data processing, hardware consulting, transportation, general construction, catering, freight transport, and post-mining waste disposal and reclamation services; software and data processing activities; insurance intermediation and administration; rail siding; and transportation of coal, coke, and cargo; and maintenance and repair of rail cars. Additionally, it is involved in designing and execution of vertical and horizontal mine workings and tunnels; leasing machinery and equipment; assembly, repair, and upkeep of machinery for the mining, quarrying, and construction industries; producing machinery for mining, quarrying, and construction; and drone usage business. The company also offers logistics, security, insurance, and training or laboratory services. Jastrzebska Spólka Weglowa S.A. was founded in 1993 and is based in Jastrzebie Zdrój, Poland.
profile.summary_fr: Jastrzebska Splka Weglowa S.A. s’occupe de l’extraction, de la production et de la vente de charbon, de coke et d’hydrocarbures en Pologne, en Autriche, en République tchèque, en Allemagne, en Slovaquie, en Belgique, en Espagne, en Norvège, en Suisse, en Roumanie, au Luxembourg, en Hollande et en France. Il opère à travers les segments du charbon, du coke et autres. La société fournit également des services d'entretien, d'inspection, de rénovation et de réparation de machines et d'équipements; des services de recherche technique; et des analyses chimiques et physico-chimiques de minéraux, ainsi que de matières et de produits solides, liquides et gazeux.
